text: A baby in a basket. A stranger alone at a well. A shepherd with a staff, standing before a king.
Every time, it looked like Musa had nothing. And every time, Allah was with him.
When he was afraid, Allah said: fear not. When he was alone, he said: my Lord, I am in need. And when the sea was in front of him, he said:
"No! Indeed, with me is my Lord. He will guide me."
Whatever is behind you, and whatever is in front of you... your Lord is with you too.
